**Overview**  
Sinar Sinar Pelancongan Sdn. Bhd. is a private limited hospitality firm incorporated on 17 January 1998, operating a boutique hotel in Kuching while its registered office is in Kuala Lumpur. The company has three directors, with Director 3 owning 56.47% of the shares and no corporate shareholders. Financial statements show unqualified audit opinions for 2022‑2024, with declining revenue and profit margins over the same period.
